subject: Confidential: developmental plan draft for Ethan Park — request for HR/Legal review
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ethan.park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential: developmental plan draft for Ethan Park — request for HR/Legal review

Team —

I want to share a first draft of a structured developmental plan (attached) for Ethan Park and request quick HR and legal review before I schedule a one-on-one to present the plan. High-level context below; full evidence is in the attached CSV and the doc.

Context summary:
- Role: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform
- Timeframe of concern: Jan–May 2025 (Q1–Q2 velocity and incident windows)
- Key gaps observed: repeated missed sprint commitments (average of 55% of assigned stories completed on time), two high-severity incidents where rollback was required and owner could not produce postmortem within 72 hours, and declining PR throughput (median review-to-merge time +72h).

What I’m proposing (draft):
- A 60-day focused developmental plan with clear measurable goals (see attachment)
- Weekly 1:1s with documented agendas + a 30/60-day checkpoint review
- Mandatory pairing sessions twice per week with a senior engineer for code quality and triage responsibilities
- Access to an external coaching resource (K. Harris — looping in separately)
- Explicit documentation of evidence and expectations; progressive steps if milestones are not met.

Ask from HR/Legal:
- Laura: please review the pacing, documentation requirements, and suggested accommodations. Anything missing from the HR template?
- Markus: please review the language in the "outcomes and consequences" section — I want to avoid tone that could be read as punitive or create an accidental admission that accelerates termination language.
- Marissa: want your read on manager-tone and alignment with people-lead expectations.

Attachments: pip_draft_v1.docx (draft notice + goals), performance-metrics.csv (compiled metrics Jan–May), coaching-plan-template.docx

This is confidential. Please reply with redlines or a brief comment by EOD so I can prep for a Wednesday sync with Ethan.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Engineering Manager — Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential: developmental plan draft for Ethan Park — request for HR/Legal review

Logan —

Thanks for the clear draft and the evidence set. Quick reads from People Ops:
- Template & pacing: The coaching and 60-day checkpoint look good. Add an explicit statement about reasonable accommodations and that participation in the plan is to support improvement, not an automatic step toward separation.
- Documentation: Please attach the specific PR & incident links that are referenced in the CSV; we need source links for auditability.
- Confidentiality & access: Limit distribution to the core group (you, me, Markus, Marissa) and HR ops. I'll keep a secure folder for the artifacts.

Minor edits I recommend (see comments in the attached coaching-plan-template.docx):
- Remove bullet phrasing like "chronically misses deadlines" and replace with specific instances and dates.
- Clarify how success is measured (X% of assigned stories completed; postmortems completed within 5 business days) and who signs off at 30/60 days.

I will:
- Upload a redlined copy to the Drive link by 3pm PT.
- Start a confidential HR-tracking ticket: HR-8242.

If you want, I can sit in on the sync with Ethan to support the tone.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. People Partner — Redwood Inference

Attachment: coaching-plan-template.docx (comments)

Logan/Laura/Marissa —

High-level legal guidance on wording and risk mitigation:
- Avoid phrasing that implies predetermined termination. Replace sections that read like "failure to meet X will result in termination" with an escalation ladder: "If milestones are not met, next steps may include extension of the plan, role redesign, or separation following standard review processes." This preserves managerial discretion and ensures process.
- Evidence retention: preserve Slack threads, PR diffs, and incident channels. Put a hold on auto-deletion for Ethan's mailbox if we anticipate further HR review — I'll coordinate with IT if needed.
- Privacy & investigators: if sensitive conduct is alleged, do not include those details in the plan; handle via HR investigation track.
- Tone: suggest adding a paragraph explaining Redwood's commitment to career growth and the supports available.

I've attached quick redlines as a .txt of suggested sentences (attached as pip_legal_redlines.txt). I also recommend a brief script for the manager conversation; I can draft that if helpful.

Markus
Markus Klein
Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pip_legal_redlines.txt (text file with sentence-level suggestions)

Next steps I will take:
- Incorporate Laura's clarity edits (link PRs + concrete dates) and Markus's redlines on escalation language by EOD.
- Share a manager script and the updated doc in the Drive folder for final sign-off.
- Schedule a private 1:1 with Ethan for Wednesday 10am PT, and invite Laura to join as optional support.

Marissa — if you're comfortable, please confirm you see this as an appropriate first step and that you don't need to loop additional senior leaders yet.

Logan
